offering_description.value: The company operates movie theaters that sell tickets and concessions to moviegoers. It owns and operates hotels and resorts serving leisure travelers, business travelers and event groups, and manages properties for third-party owners.

primary_products.value: Cinema concessions; prepared food and beverages

primary_services.value: Movie exhibition; hotel and resort lodging; restaurant dining; meeting and banquet services; hotel management

customer_segment.value: B2C: Moviegoers, leisure and business travelers, diners and private event hosts; B2B: Corporate travel and meeting buyers, event planners, advertisers and third-party hotel owners

end_markets.value: Cinema entertainment; leisure and business travel; meetings and events; foodservice; cinema advertising

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: Movie admissions; product sales: Theater concessions and food and beverages at hospitality properties; service fees: Hotel stays and meeting and banquet services; commissions or management fees: Operating hotels on behalf of property owners; advertising: Advertising shown to cinema audiences
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; product sales; service fees; commissions or management fees; advertising

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: Operates theaters using films booked from distributors and runs hotels and resorts for travelers and event groups; service provider: Manages hotel operations and guest services for third-party property owners

geography_served.value: US regional: Theaters span multiple U.S. regions, with a Midwest concentration and hotels primarily in the Midwest.

specialization.value: diversified: Movie theaters and concessions alongside hotel and resort operations, dining, events and third-party hotel management

distribution_channels.value: own locations: Theater box offices and concession stands, hotel front desks and on-site restaurants; online: Company ticketing and hotel reservation websites and apps; partners / resellers: Third-party movie ticketing platforms, hotel brand reservation networks and online travel agencies; direct sales: Hotel sales teams serving corporate travel accounts, meetings and private events
distribution_channels.category: own locations; online; partners / resellers; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Theaters and hotels follow accessibility and fire codes, health department food safety rules and state liquor licensing requirements.

notes: The exact current theater and hotel footprint is uncertain.
